description: This file contains utility functions and constants related to Cuttlefish configuration, such as environment variable retrieval, path configurations, and device-specific settings. It declares functions for obtaining instance identifiers, paths, and support capabilities, primarily used for configuring and managing Cuttlefish virtual machine instances.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the instance number from environment variable or username.

methods.name: GetDefaultVsockCid
methods.description: Computes default Vsock CID based on instance number.

methods.name: GetVsockServerPort
methods.description: Calculates the vsock server port number given a base and guest CID.

methods.name: GetGlobalConfigFileLink
methods.description: Provides path to the global config file link for VM configuration access.

methods.name: ForCurrentInstance
methods.description: Modifies a prefix string to be unique per instance.

methods.name: InstanceFromString
methods.description: Parses an instance number from a string.

methods.name: RandomSerialNumber
methods.description: Generates a random serial number appended to a prefix.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Returns default host artifacts directory path based on a file.

methods.name: DefaultQemuBinaryDir
methods.description: Provides the default directory path for QEMU binaries.

methods.name: HostBinaryPath
methods.description: Returns the path to a host binary given its name.

methods.name: HostUsrSharePath
methods.description: Returns the path to shared resources in the host system.

methods.name: HostQemuBiosPath
methods.description: Provides the path to the QEMU BIOS files.

methods.name: DefaultGuestImagePath
methods.description: Returns the default path for guest images.

methods.name: DefaultEnvironmentPath
methods.description: Provides path based on environment key and default value.

methods.name: HostSupportsQemuCli
methods.description: Checks if the host supports QEMU command-line interface.

methods.name: UseQemuPrebuilt
methods.description: Indicates whether to use prebuilt QEMU binaries.
